prep.h2: NDT Level 3 exam preparation course: what it covers
prep.intro: First-time ASNT NDT Level III candidates pass the NDT Basic exam and at least one Method exam. The Basic covers five areas, and preparation works through each of them:
domains: SNT-TC-1A and ANSI/ASNT CP-189 in detail: qualification versus certification, the written practice, training and experience by level and method, the general, specific and practical exams, vision, recertification and revocation.
Level II-degree familiarity with the common methods beyond your own, and method selection for a given component and discontinuity.
How a training programme is structured, how classroom hours relate to experience, and how training records are kept under a written practice.
Metals, heat treatment and the manufacturing and in-service processes that create discontinuities, linked to the method that finds each one.
How the documents fit together, what a procedure must contain, how acceptance criteria are applied and who approves a procedure.

prep.after: Study is self-paced online, with an ASNT NDT Level III answering your questions, and enrolment is open all year. See the Level III Basic exam prep page, the ASNT Level III study guide and ASNT Level 3 requirements.

faq: How much does NDT Level 3 certification cost?

Two parts. The online Level III refresher is priced per method in the fee table on this page and covers course access, study materials, mock exams and instructor support. ASNT's own exam fees are separate and paid to ASNT: one NDT Basic exam plus at least one Method exam, at member or nonmember rates, as listed in the ASNT table on this page.
